_authoringNotes: WORK_ORDER_1216 -- EVERY KILL PAYS WOOD / IRON / GOLD / STONE. Owner ruling 2026-08-26: "wood iron gold stone, balance it so i can afford to repair by grinding some kills" and "lets do around 20 per enemy per kill". These are the ONLY numbers that set the material payout; they are DATA so the owner retunes in one edit with NO recompile (loaded by KillRewardBalanceCatalog in Enemy.cs via CanonicalJson -- the Resources/Data/Canonical copy WINS at runtime, StreamingAssets is the desktop/editor source; KEEP THE TWO BYTE-IDENTICAL). FORMULA: materialBase = clamp(round(goldBase * goldToMaterialMultiplier * perMaterialMultiplier[m]), materialFloorPerKill, materialCapPerKill), then variance-rolled through the ONE authority EnemyDef.RollReward with the enemy's own rewardVariance so all four materials feel like one drop. goldBase is the SAME resolved base the WO-432/433 gold grant uses (EnemyDef.CoinReward, else max(4, xpReward*0.4)) so every enemy pays and the payout scales with difficulty. WHY 1.1: measured from enemies.json (19 rows, 2026-08-26) gold base is min 3 / median 18 / mean 31.1 / max 120; 1.1 puts the MEDIAN enemy (troll-mage, gold 18) at 20 -- the ruled number -- while preserving scale-with-difficulty. A FLAT 20 was considered and REJECTED: it makes farming the weakest enemy optimal. A 0.25 constant was discussed earlier and is SUPERSEDED (it was agreed on a misread of per-WAVE vs per-KILL and pays ~10x under intent). WHY FLOOR 6: cellar-hollow (gold 3) would otherwise pay 3 and a kill that pays almost nothing reads as broken. WHY CAP 40: uncapped, a necromancer (gold 120) pays 132 of EVERY material, so one boss out-earns a whole wave and the felt curve inverts. STONE: the Stone the HUD shows is Resources.Food / EconomyService.Food (DEF-121 repurposed the retired Stone axis). The grant goes through EconomyService like wood and iron. GameState.Stone is a second, phantom balance shown nowhere and spent by nothing -- NEVER route a reward there (WO-1212). GOLD is NOT listed here: it keeps its existing WO-432/433 grant unchanged and is the reference the other three derive from -- do not add a gold multiplier or it double-pays. perMaterialMultiplier is the per-resource override seam: 1.0 = the shared constant. Raise wood or iron here if repair still feels out of reach after a felt-test (reference: Repair All = 155 Wood / 78 Iron, ~8 kills at the shipped constant).
